name: RunDaySchedule
description: The work-day decision code (plan 04.11, part A), called hourly by DayRunner and by the button "משוך עכשיו מפריוריטי". Reads the hours from AgentSettings (morningPullAt 06:00, bankCheckAt 09:00, bankRecheckAt 10:00; an hour with minutes runs at the next round hour) and today's ImportBatches rows (kind משיכת בוקר – Priority / בדיקת דף בנק, runPhase), and runs only the phases that are due and have not run successfully today. Ensures the plan's AgentSettings rows exist (creates a missing row once from the plan default with its basis, reported in settingsCreated; bankRecheckAt takes the old receiptsReadyBy value when present). 06:00 phase: PullPriorityCustomers → PullOpenMovements → PullOpenOrders → CloseSettledNotes (months at 0 ₪ close their notes) → the existing morning task scan (RefreshInvoiceLayer → BuildTasks, which since stage 2 also builds the grouped note tasks whose noteTask.<type>.runAt is morningPullAt: להתקשר לפרטי אשראי, צ׳ק אצל סוכן – אין קבלה, לחזור ללקוח, תזכורות) → one ImportBatches row (kind משיכת בוקר – Priority, runMode, runPhase 06:00, runSummary per step). If a pull fails nothing is deleted or closed, the phase is not counted as run (retried next hour) and one task משיכת הבוקר נכשלה (key day-pull-failed:<date>) is opened; it closes on the next successful pull. Bank-check phase (09:00 bankCheckAt; 10:00 bankRecheckAt only when 09:00 did not find the bank statement; when both are due in the same run — a missed hour — they run once as the 10:00 check): is the bank statement in Priority? (until the API: the test source of SyncPriorityBankLines has lines for the day). Loaded → the existing receipts run (SyncPriorityBankLines, dryRun false) → the field agents' cheques (PullAgentReceipts' shared logic, in-process; its failure is recorded in runSummary as a failed step and never stops the phase; reported in bankCheck.agentReceipts) → PullOpenMovements → CloseSettledNotes → CheckCommitments → the grouped commitment task התחייבויות שלא קוימו – ליצור קשר (runAt bankCheckAt) → the urgent task closes. Not loaded at 09:00 → recorded (bankLoaded false), nothing else. Not loaded at 10:00 → one urgent task דף הבנק לא עלה לפריוריטי (key bank-missing:<date>, severity קריטית, source תקבולים) and no commitment check that day (commitments are checked on the next day the bank loads). Each bank-check run writes one ImportBatches row (kind בדיקת דף בנק, runPhase 09:00 / 10:00, bankLoaded, runSummary). A failed step leaves the phase uncounted (retried next hour). mode ידני runs only the 06:00 phase now regardless of the hour (the button). dryRun (default true) reports the decision and each step's dryRun. Never writes to Priority or contacts anyone.

mode.description: מתוזמן = hourly DayRunner; ידני = the button, runs the 06:00 phase now

dryRun.description: Default true: only report what would run and be written

asOfDate.description: Testing: the day, YYYY-MM-DD (default today, Asia/Jerusalem)

bankScenario.description: Test source only: whether the bank statement is in Priority today (passed to the bank-lines test source)

notBuiltYet.description: Phases not built yet (empty since stage 2)

pulledAt.description: When the 06:00 phase finished (for "נמשך מפריוריטי ב-HH:MM")

bankCheck.description: {phase, loaded, linesFound, receiptsRun, commitments, urgentTask: open / close / none}

usageDescription:
This action is triggered by:

- **Bookkeeper on the aging report**: Clicks "משוך עכשיו מפריוריטי" at the top of the aging report (גבייה → דוח גיול), whenever they want fresher numbers
  Pulls customers, open balances and open orders from Priority right away, then refreshes the collection tasks. A line on the screen says what was pulled, or what failed, and the report reloads. Until the Priority connection is set up, it shows a calm notice that the connection is not set up yet.
- **Every work-day morning, automatically**: Runs each round hour between 06:00 and 12:00, Sunday to Thursday
  Does the day's scheduled steps at the hours set in Settings → לוח זמנים, so the report is up to date before the team starts.
